title: Analista financeiro
description:
Sobre a vaga

A Baggio e Carvalho Engenharia é uma empresa de médio porte, especializada em gestão e execução de obras comerciais e residenciais desde 1986. A empresa vem em um ritmo de crescimento interessante nos últimos anos e está buscando pessoas para somar e crescer com ela.

Estamos em busca de um(a)
Analista Administrativo de Obra
(Financeiro) para atuar em nossa obra, um projeto com alto volume de controle e exigência de detalhamento junto ao cliente. Procuramos alguém dinâmico(a), organizado(a) e com atenção aos detalhes, contribuindo para a eficiência dos processos administrativos e financeiros da obra.

Principais atividades da função:

.Controlar e manter atualizado o caixinha da obra e os reembolsos, garantindo que não haja virada de mês sem fechamento;

.Receber, conferir e lançar todas as notas fiscais da obra (APs, PPCs e PCTs) no Sienge, observando dados de faturamento, retenções e prazos de pagamento;

.Verificar se as retenções de impostos (PCC, IR, INSS) estão de acordo com o ensinado e devolver ao fornecedor quando houver divergências;

.Verificar o CNAE na nota fiscal do fornecedor, assegurando que esteja compatível com o serviço prestado;

.Conferir o endereço da obra nas notas fiscais, garantindo que esteja conforme o solicitado pelo cliente;

.Cobrar as apropriações da engenharia para lançamento das APs e controle financeiro;

.Emitir e conferir relatórios de pedidos de compra em aberto, boletins de medição e saldos de contratos, cobrando notas fiscais correspondentes;

.Controlar adiantamentos de fornecedores, solicitando NFs referentes a entregas e serviços;

.Enviar contratos para assinatura digital e realizar liberação no Sienge após conferência dos documentos;

.Lançar aditivos positivos e negativos conforme solicitação da engenharia;

.Emitir e conferir relatório "Administração de Obras", montar RP e enviar ao financeiro corporativo com as notas e documentos exigidos pelo cliente;

.Acompanhar relatórios de distorção por apropriação e de saldos de credores, cobrando notas fiscais de fornecedores já pagos por adiantamento;

.Enviar relatório diário de notas lançadas e faturadas contra a Baggio;

.Acompanhar e garantir o envio das CNDs mensais e documentação de terceiros;

.No encerramento da obra, realizar o fechamento financeiro completo, assegurando que não existam saldos, pendências ou notas a lançar/pagar;

.Apoiar demandas administrativas e financeiras do gestor de obra e da equipe de engenharia.

Pré-requisitos:

.Formação completa em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas afins;

.Experiência anterior em rotinas administrativas e financeiras de obra;

.Excel intermediário ou avançado;

.Perfil proativo, sistemático e detalhista, com boa capacidade de organização;

.Facilidade de comunicação e comprometimento com prazos e qualidade das entregas.

Desejável:

.Conhecimento em Sienge;

.Experiência em obras com múltiplos CNPJs e contratos diferenciados;

.Conhecimento em processos de medição e apropriação de custos;

.Vivência em relacionamento direto com clientes corporativos e processos de auditoria financeira.

Somos um Grupo formado por marcas que possuem mais de 45 anos de experiência na área da saúde, e estamos presentes nos estados do Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Espirito Santo e Ceará realizando mais de 456 mil consultas anuais e cuidando da vida de mais de 100 mil pacientes. Nossos valores


Pessoas são o nosso DNA: Somos justos nas relações com os pacientes, colegas de trabalho, parceiros e prestadores de serviço. Incentivamos sonhos e valorizamos as pessoas por suas competências.

Simplificamos para fazer bem feito: Antecipamos os problemas e buscamos realizar as atividades da forma mais eficiente, agindo de imediato e de forma coordenada com foco na solução.

Queremos mais: Buscamos incansavelmente a evolução, valorizando feedbacks e nos preocupando em sempre entregar a melhor experiência.

Empoderamos as pessoas: Somos proativos para solucionar problemas e buscar oportunidades, assumimos responsabilidade pelas atividades exercidas, sem transferi-la para outros.

title: Technical Coordinator
description:
Result of Service

The Technical Coordinator reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

São Gonçalo, Brazil

Expected duration

Five (5) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. In 2023, UN-Habitat launched a project with the aim of supporting the Municipality of São Gonçalo to reduce social inequalities based on the fulfillment of the 2030 Agenda. This project is dedicated to improving the capacities and conditions of the local administration in monitoring urban conditions and trends at the local level, providing evidence-based information to build sustainable and locally integrated urban policies. In 2024, UN-Habitat was invited to contribute to the development of the participatory Action Plan for a project under the Periferia Viva Programme, aimed at the urbanization of an informal settlement, with resources already secured for its implementation. To ensure the successful implementation of this project, UN-Habitat is creating a new team, which includes this Technical Coordinator position. To implement this project in São Gonçalo, a Technical Coordinator is required to ensure the effective execution of the work program. This role will be performed in person at an outpost established in the Ipuca Community in São Gonçalo. The Technical Coordinator will be responsible for coordinating project activities and staff, ensuring compliance with security guidelines, and fostering engagement with local stakeholders to support the initiative's sustainable urban development. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Technical Coordinator reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Technical Coordinator will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: 1. Technically coordinate the actions of the Ipuca Project – Periferia Viva Programme
• Provide technical coordination for the project, according to programme documents and signed agreement.
• Prepare technical documents and review all materials produced by the team, consolidating them into cohesive final deliverables for submission to the local partner, ensuring alignment with the project's agreed outcomes and indicators, and with Periferia Viva Programme rules.
• Oversee periodic project follow-up activities in collaboration with the partner, as stipulated in the Work Plan or determined at subsequent stages.
• Ensure that the technical activities are aligned with the quality expectations of the Agency and its counterparts.
• Gather inputs and coordinate the preparation of work plans, periodic narrative progress reports and expenditures status reports to the programme coordination in São Gonçalo.
• Prepare Terms of Reference and develop detailed scopes of services for project outputs, ensuring clear understanding of expectations and deliverables to prospective consultancies.
• Ensure programme implementation as per the work plan with support from programme staff.
• Establish systems for programme planning, implementation and monitoring, in collaboration with partners.
• Anticipate and mitigate risks to the programme, including relevant challenges or omissions and other situations that may affect development and implementation of the programme.
• Provide information for the systematization and exchange of successful practices and experiences with other offices in the region and with headquarters divisions.
• Provide technical support on how to localize and give shape to international agreements and frameworks, such as the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, the New Urban Agenda, presenting ideas on how to implement these agendas in the territories.
• Record and maintain documents on relevant programme activities, issues, and risks. 2. Relationship with partners and other stakeholders
• Maintain relationships with local partners to support the implementation of the Ipuca Project (Periferia Viva Program), identify potential problems, and resolve any conflicts throughout the process.
• Ensure effective and efficient communication with counterparts and local partners, such as local governments (several Secretariats), civil society organizations, community leaders, Universities, private sector, etc.
• Identify capacity building needs and support partners through technical assistance, mentoring, training and capacity development initiatives, as needed. 3. Support the coordination of the programme's monitoring and reporting
• Gather and compile all necessary information for monitoring and reporting from the planning to the evaluation stages.
• Monitor the implementation of activities and the expenditure of funds; conduct regular monitoring activities.
• Draft and provide inputs to annual and quarterly reports. 4. Advocate and facilitate knowledge building, management and communication
• Document the programme implementation process and products.
• Contribute to the exchange of information and provide inputs to the development of knowledge products internally and externally of the programme.
• Coordinate the organization of major advocacy campaigns, events, trainings, workshops and knowledge products.
• Attend meetings and conferences promoted by partners to strengthen the project's position and presence in the territories.
• Undertake any other duties and responsibilities within the incumbent's expertise that can be reasonably expected to help maximize the efficiency and effectiveness of UN-Habitat's response to urban development issues.
• Perform other duties which may be requested by the supervisor. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should be familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Technical Coordinator will support the implementation of the project activities according to the responsibilities indicated above. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office of monthly activities' report.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Postgraduate degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Architecture and Urbanism, Social Work, Environmental Management, Social Housing, Project Management, Urban Studies or related fields, or additional five (5) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
• Bachelor's degree in Architecture and Urbanism, Engineering, Social Work, or related fields, is required. Work experience:
• Minimum of seven (7) years of experience in slum upgrading projects or working with urban communities is required, including at least five (5) years of experience in project coordination, team leadership and community mobilization, in/or the following: o Slum upgrading project and/or construction, developed using participatory methodology; o Land tenure regularization initiatives in favelas or urban communities, developed using participatory methodology; o Social work in slum upgrading projects, housing production, interventions in at-risk areas, housing resettlement, etc.; o Technical Assistance for Social Interest Housing (ATHIS) initiatives, such as home renovations and improvements, feasibility studies for housing projects, and related activities; o Technical advisory services for design and/or construction of housing produced through collective self-help and/or self-managed systems; o Risk and disaster prevention interventions in favelas or urban communities, developed using participatory methodology; o Participatory development of sector-specific plans, such as Sanitation Plans, Local Housing Plans, and Mobility Plans; o Experience in urban intervention projects in peripheral/marginalized territories focusing on environment, sustainability and/or resilience is desirable.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Good computer skills in Windows, as Microsoft Office, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Web search engines is required.
• Good handling of technological tools and use of software and online platforms is desirable.
• Good handling of online events and conference tools is desirable.
• Good knowledge of project management methodologies is desirable. Competencies:
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of English and Spanish is desirable.

Additional Information

Travel details: Applicable. The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. Remuneration LICA 4. UNOPS Salary Scale. Notes Appointment against this post is on local basis and only nationals from Brazil or external candidates who hold a permanent visa in Brazil may apply. The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. It is required for all the curricular information to be inserted in the system, which may take a few hours. Only complete applications in English will be considered. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence. Due to the volume of applications received, receipt of applications cannot be acknowledged individually. Only short-listed applicants will be contacted. Applications should be submitted through INSPIRA and must include all documents required at the system, please be ready to include the following information at the "Candidate Profile" (CP) at Inspira:
• Cover memo (maximum 1 page)
• Educational Background (incl. dates)
• Professional Experience (assignments, tasks, achievements, duration by years/ months)
• Expertise and preferences regarding location of potential assignments
• Other Experience and Expertise (e.g. Internships/ voluntary work, etc.)* * Please note that Internships, self-employment and part-time count as 50%. In addition to it, note experience not relevant to the position will not be considered. All applications should be submitted to: Inspira UN-HABITAT does not charge a fee at any stage of the recruitment process. If you have any questions concerning people or companies claiming to be recruiting on behalf of these offices and requesting the payment of a fee, please contact:

title: Sales Manager
description:
Be visionary

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.​

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

Job Description

Teledyne Marine is a group of leading-edge undersea technology companies that have been assembled by Teledyne Technologies Incorporated. Through acquisitions and collaboration, over the past 10 years Teledyne Marine has evolved into an industry powerhouse, bringing the best of the best together under a single umbrella. With technologies divided into 5 core segments; Imaging, Instruments, Interconnect, Seismic and Vehicles, Teledyne Marine sales staff can address not only brand level solutions, but turn-key, customized systems that leverage our full range of technology. Our goal is to provide one-stop purchasing capability, world-wide customer support, and the technical expertise to solve our customer's toughest challenges. A Sea of Solutions…..One Supplier.

For more information, visit our website at

POSITION WILL BE BASED IN Brazil - São Paulo

JOB SUMMARY:

The Sales Manager is responsible for Sales of Teledyne Marine products in the defined area both directly and through distributors, specific responsibility to support the Central & South America's for Teledyne Marine's Imaging & Instruments and Vehicles verticals.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsibility to build and maintain an active pipeline in a CRM, Salesforce, to exceed orders and sales targets on a quarterly, and annual basis.  

  • Provide accurate booking forecasts and keep up-to-date customer and pipeline records.

  • Actively manage the channels to ensure they are fully engaged, optimized, and driven to succeed.

  • Develop and drive a regional sales strategy to maximize market penetration of Teledyne Marine Instruments & Imaging and Vehicles products including new market entries both direct and with channel partners.

  • Orchestrate and hold technical seminars, product presentations and customer demonstrations direct and in conjunction with partners and channels.

  • Remain informed of competitor status, products, advantages, and weaknesses.

  • Develop and maintain a solid understanding of market conditions and trends.

  • Identify opportunities and capture market share growth while collaborating with the Teledyne Marine businesses to optimize efforts.

  • Be responsible for discovering Teledyne Marine non-standard sales opportunities and participate in the selling process in collaboration with product management.

  • Understand fully the benefits and functionality of each of the products in Teledyne Marine Instruments & Imaging and Vehicles portfolio and how they compare within the market.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent experience

  • Relevant background/education in a maritime organization would be advantageous, specifically hydrography.     

  • Retired Naval Officer with Hydrography experience is a plus

SKILLS:

  • Strong interpersonal acumen, communicate effectively from entry level to C-suite customers.

  • Languages needed – English, Spanish, Portuguese, all at working level.

  • Excellent communication ability with all nationalities, written as well as verbal.

  • Ability to have or attain good comprehension of technical/maritime issues.

AUTHORITIES:

  • Providing quotations to Agents/Reps within pricing authority

  • Providing quotations to customers within pricing authority

  • Recommend termination and hiring of Agents/Reps within the region based on defined performance criteria

METRICS:

  • Booking Target

  • Revenue Target

  • Quarterly reports on Agents / Reps

  • Ability to provide timely and accurate booking prognosis.

  • Ability to provide qualitative feedback on market conditions and trends, new customer applications and product ideas

  • Ability to report competitive activity

Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.

Company Description

At Turner & Townsend we're passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people to realize their potential and doing our part to create a prosperous society.

Every day we help our major global clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects, in over 50 countries worldwide.

Our team is dynamic, innovative and client-focused, supported by an inclusive and fun company culture. Our clients value our proactive approach, depth of expertise, integrity and the quality we deliver. As a result, our people get to enjoy working on some of the most exciting projects in the world.

Job Description

Purpose to deliver and maintain standard, consistent, and global real-time payments reflecting the assessed risk parameters for each project.

  • Manages the volumes of purchase order activities required to support business purchasing requirements within an end-to-end cycle that aims to pay the 3rd Party suppliers within agreed payment terms.
  • Ensure Request to Pay transactions and workflows are processed and that all associated day−to−day activities are delivered at top−quartile performance levels.
  • Resolve Request to Pay issues with Requisitioners, Procurement Staff, Vendors, Tax and Finance, and ensure that Request to Pay processes are understood and followed.
  • Create Purchase Requisition (PR), Purchase order (PO) and Service Entry (SE) from ERP Requisitions.
  • Maintain PR/ SE and resolve any associated queries on a timely basis. This involves close liaison with the designated invoice query focal point, the Business community and Accounts Payable.
  • Request Outline Agreement creation.
  • Identify and analyze diligently all the issues related to Non-Compliance and late payment of invoices and improve the performance.
  • Identify potential Request to Pay Continuous Improvement opportunities in support of the drive for greater Request to Pay efficiency (especially opportunities for greater automation, and consolidation of activity), and possibly take part in these continues improvement initiatives to assist in the implementation and execution of actions arising.
  • Work in close coordination with Category managers, Procurement Managers and Senior Buyers in maintenance of Contracts and Outline Agreements in ERP System.

Qualifications

  • Degree in business, economics, finance, mathematics, and engineering;
  • Excellent analytical, oral and written communication skills both in Portuguese and English - Mandatory;
  • Previous experience with SAP and Business Warehouse Software;
  • Advanced Excel skills;
  • Knowledge and/or experience with contract/procurement process would be a plus;
  • Previous experience with PR/PO and processing invoices would be a plus;
  • Fully versed with Request to Pay principles, techniques and industry standard tools;
  • Minimum of 2 years industry experience.

description:
A
SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina
é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,
Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS)
e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
Promover ações de apoio matricial às equipes de saúde da família com o intuito de qualificar e ampliar o escopo das ações da atenção básica bem como qualificar a situação de saúde da população. Apoiar as equipes de saúde na família na realização do manejo das situações de saúde mental e risco psicossocial na atenção básica, propiciando, ainda, o acesso ao sistema de saúde e à reinserção social.

RESOLVE: Art. 1º Define como requisito obrigatório para a atuação na equipe multiprofissional do Núcleo de Apoio à Saúde da Família e Atenção Básica (NASF-AB)
ao menos 2 (dois) dos critérios abaixo:

  • 1º Ter no mínimo 3 (três) anos de experiência de atuação direta no saúde da família ou no núcleo de apoio à saúde da família.
  • 2º Ter no mínimo 5 (cinco) anos de experiência profissional na área da saúde.
  • 3º Ter no mínimo 3 (três) anos de experiência de atuação em um centro de atenção psicossocial (CAPS).

title: Tech Talent Program | 2025
description:
Viridien ) is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

Job Summary

We are seeking passionate and innovative problem-solvers to join our Subsurface Imaging team at Viridien.

In this role, you will apply your expertise in math, physics, and technology to address real-world challenges that shape the future of energy, infrastructure, and Earth data solutions. Working alongside leading experts, you will contribute to projects that transform how we explore and understand our planet.

Through comprehensive training and mentorship, you will learn to convert raw seismic data into high-resolution 3D models of the Earth's subsurface—unlocking insights that support sustainable exploration and environmental protection.

In this role, you will:

  • Apply advanced physics, mathematics, and geoscience principles to process and interpret seismic data.
  • Use state-of-the-art imaging techniques and high-performance computing (HPC) to solve complex geophysical challenges.
  • Collaborate with diverse teams to design innovative algorithms, tools, and workflows.
  • Partner with Research and Software Development teams to shape next-generation technologies.
  • Contribute to scientific publications, present findings, and drive innovation across the field

About the Team

You will join a diverse and innovative group of professionals tackling some of the world's most complex geophysical challenges. Our collaborative environment fosters creativity, knowledge-sharing, and professional growth. You will have opportunities to work on pioneering research, contribute to publications, and develop new technologies in a fast-paced, high-impact setting

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
Focusing on offshore and onshore logistics operations, this position will plan, coordinate, and execute the movement of materials, equipment, and personnel. The role will lead the logistics team and oversee all logistics aspects, including vessel, helicopter, and shorebase contracts and monitoring, ensuring efficient day-to-day operations, timely and cost-effective deliveries, optimized cargo planning, and accurate logistics documentation and reporting.
Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate and execute logistics operations for the transportation of materials, equipment, and personnel between onshore bases, warehouses, ports, and offshore units.
  • Manage and oversee vessel contracts, ensuring effective day-to-day coordination, performance monitoring, and operational efficiency.
  • Manage and oversee helicopter contracts, ensuring safe and timely operations in line with company requirements.
  • Manage and oversee shorebase contracts, monitoring performance and ensuring service quality and compliance.
  • Lead the logistics team and all logistics activities, driving efficiency, cost optimization, and alignment with project and operational needs.
  • Ensure full compliance with company policies, customs regulations, import/export legislation, and health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards.
  • Monitor freight movements (road, sea, and air) and ensure timely deliveries and collections to support operations.
  • Liaise with freight forwarders, customs brokers, port authorities, and internal stakeholders to optimize logistics planning and execution.
  • Prepare and verify shipping documents, including invoices, packing lists, manifests, and customs clearance forms.
  • Follow up on material requisitions, dispatches, returns, and cargo tracking using ERP systems and logistics software.
  • Coordinate and optimize cargo consolidation and manifest planning to reduce freight costs and improve turnaround.
  • Ensure proper packaging, labeling, and preservation of materials in accordance with applicable standards and offshore requirements.
  • Control documentation for hazardous materials (IMO/ADR/IATA) and ensure safe transport in compliance with regulations.
  • Track inventory movements between locations and support warehouse activities when required.
  • Maintain accurate records of all shipments, freight costs, delays, and delivery KPIs.
  • Support the preparation of logistics procedures, manuals, and compliance reports.
  • Assist in contractor performance evaluation and cost control initiatives within the logistics function.
  • Participate in daily/weekly operations meetings to align logistics activities with planning and operational needs.
  • Respond to operational challenges and emergencies, proposing mitigation measures and alternative logistics solutions.
  • Coordinate crew change logistics when required, including travel, immigration, and accommodation arrangements.
  • Provide logistics support for regulatory inspections or audits related to customs, cargo, and HSE.
Requirements

Education:

  • Technical or university degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or related field.

Experience

  • Experience in logistics coordination, preferably in oil & gas.
  • Familiarity with freight forwarding, customs clearance, and offshore logistics operations.

description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Avaliar, treinar e adaptar usuários para utilização de OPM - Órteses, próteses e meios auxiliares;

Realizar anamnese, avaliação física e funcional, aplicar e interpretar escalas, questionários, testes funcionais e exames complementares para determinar o diagnóstico, prognóstico fisioterapêutico, PTS e estabelecer as condições de alta fisioterapêutica de pacientes adultos e pediátricos;

Prescrever órteses, próteses, meios auxiliares de locomoção, adaptações e tecnologia assistiva para otimizar, adaptar ou manter atividades funcionais com vistas à autonomia e independência funcional;

Registrar em prontuário eletrônico consultas, avaliações, diagnósticos, prognósticos, tratamentos, evolução, intercorrências e altas fisioterapêuticas;

Emitir laudos, pareceres, relatórios e atestados fisioterapêuticos;

Elaborar e realizar atividades de educação em saúde, orientar e capacitar os usuários, cuidadores e acompanhantes para a promoção de uma maior funcionalidade e autonomia dos usuários, bem como na prevenção de riscos ambientais;

Planejar e executar estratégias de adequações com vistas à acessibilidade a ambientes públicos e privados, como também planejar adequações em ambiente domiciliar, escolar, laboral e de lazer;

Participar dos estudos de caso, discussão e processos de educação permanente na área da saúde dos usuários acompanhados pelo Serviço de Reabilitação Física e Intelectual desta Área de Planejamento.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação Completa em Fisioterapia;
  • Pós Graduação na área de atuação;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Experiência de 6 (seis) meses na área.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Valores

  • Ética

title: Sr Control
description:
Job Purpose


The Senior Automation Engineer shall create, verify and qualify engineering solutions for both subsea and topside applications, supporting customer value-driven purpose in the Automation & Controls business in the oil and gas industry, in particular challenging product development environments in accordance with TechnipFMC standards and processes, and also following the best practices according to Lean Product and Process Development frameworks. Secure compliance on safety, quality, performance, and configurability on controls and automation products and system designs of TechnipFMC products according to legislation, industry standards and customer requirements. This role requires staying updated on technological advances, particularly in automation, electronics, communication, power, networking, sensing and robotics. At the senior level, responsibilities include managing customer expectations and ensuring product quality throughout the project's life cycle—from tender to field operations.

Job Description

  • Work cross functionally with product engineers, architecture engineers, system engineers and software engineers to ensure products meet controls and automation business success criteria.
  • Collaborate with other engineering areas at TechnipFMC, as well with the whole value stream representative areas at Controls and Automation department during project execution, to guarantee an integrated solution that meets the system and product life cycle requirements.
  • Identify and create new technologies and ideas to increase the organization's intellectual property and to better address customer needs.Responsible for selection of design concepts, development platforms, development tools, component families and design methodologies for relevant scope in controls and automation integrated with system solutions.
  • Conduct project development tasks for the hardware development activities in accordance with industrial standards and main business requirements, performing detailed design and conducting functional verification.
  • Perform technical review of design concepts and conduct product development main tasks according to TechnipFMC standards and process.
  • Participate in communications with internal and external customers when relevant.
  • Conduct feasibility studies for development of new products and systemsEstablish component, product and subsystem specifications.
  • Utilize state-of-the-art technology, methodology and know-how to achieve cost optimum designs with high quality and performance.
  • Execute qualification programs on components, product and system level including functional, environmental, system operation mode.
  • Maintain developer competence and obtain relevant new competence required for new development projects.
  • Familiarize with relevant standards for subsea control systems.
  • Mentor team in development technologies, tools, and processes
  • Location: Tech Center, Ilha do Fundão - Rio de Janeiro

You are meant for this job if:

  • Bachelor's degree - Engineering.
  • CREA
  • Fluent English (global team)
  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with testing tools for web application such as Playwright or Cypress
  • Experience with Atlassian products such as Jira and Confluence
  • Experience with Test Management Tool - X-Ray
  • Experience working in cross-functional team using Agile and SCRUM methodologies.
  • Exposure to the principals of Industrial Protocols, Platforms and APIs:  OPC UA, Profibus, Modbus (RTU, TCP).
  • Very good understanding of QA best practices (including test scenario management and reporting tools).
  • Understanding of Hardware In the Loop (HIL), Software In the Loop (SIL)
  • Exposure to Configuration Management tools (Version control, bug tracking, change management, automated builds, and coding standards)
  • Basic knowledge of Monitoring and Observability tools is a plus;

title: Senior Completion and Intervention Engineer
description:
This position is for a Well Completion Engineer, responsible for designing and planning well completions, coordinating interventions, and supporting execution activities to ensure safe and efficient well operations from preparation to final closeout.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and present well design concepts based on information provided by the Subsurface team.
  • Assist with the preparation of cost estimates used to generate yearly budgets and well/project specific AFE's.
  • Forecast and be accountable for the timely ordering of well/project specific long lead requirements.
  • Contribute towards logistical coordination and quality assurance of services, materials, equipment and personnel.
  • Integrate with fellow drilling, completion/testing, subsea and/or subsurface team members as required.
  • Perform special studies/duties if/as required, including conducting service quality meetings.
  • Ensure vendor service deficiencies are correctly and timely captured via the company non-conformance reporting (NCR) process to ensure timely action/close out.
  • Support NCR and root cause failure analysis as required.
  • Contribute to the development, management and updating of the Drilling Management System (DMS).
  • Ensure the DMS is followed during well planning, design, engineering, execution and closeout activities.
  • Ensure compliance with company and Drilling & Completion policies, standards and approved procedures.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied materials, equipment and services, including review of design, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Support the preparation of HSE documents if/where required.
  • Contribute and participate in the hazard identification process.
  • Contribute and participate in well/project specific risk assessments and pre-job planning meetings.
  • Assist with the evaluation of rig and third-party services for hazards, well integrity and assurance.
  • Support Drilling Management if requested in ER roles and incident investigations.

Well/Project Specific Duties:

  • Provide engineering support as part of the wells team, including optimizing well planning, design, engineering, costing and assisting with operation execution, as well as the services associated with these activities. Activities include performing offset reviews and well hazard identification.
  • Establish subsurface well/project life cycle functional and operational requirements, including material and equipment selection.
  • Identify special engineering studies to be performed.
  • Prepare well/project specific technical notes if/when required.
  • Prepare detailed scopes of work for tender documents, perform vendor capability assessments, evaluate tenders methodically and present a succinct recommendation.
  • Raise requisitions and purchase orders.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied goods, materials, equipment and services, including review of design, manufacturing processes, quality plans, post-manufacturing testing/verification, site receipt acceptance, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Review all applicable operating, installing and testing procedures, including interface documents.
  • Assist with drilling-related engineering, mobilisation, installation and commissioning activities if/when required.
  • Contribute and participate in DWOP/CWOP/IWOP's as part of well/project commencement.
  • Ensure the Well Barrier Schematic is current and valid for the current operation being performed.
  • Assist with preparation of Management of Change (MOC) documents and conducting a risk assessment for those changes with relevant parties.
  • Review field tickets and/or well invoices.
  • Review the engineering-focused After Action Review (AAR) report and apply lessons learnt.
  • Responsible for compilation of End of Well Reports (EOWRs).

Requirements

Education:

  • Degree in Engineering 
  • Well Control certification (IWCF) - Subsea/Surface Supervisor is considered an advantage.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant Well Completion and Well Intervention engineering experience.
  • At least 5 years experience with operators in Brazil including IOCs.
  • Project experience on dry tree development(s) including exposure to conceptual and detailed design as well as execution of completions and well intervention operations.
  • Experience with lower completion and sand control designs and execution.
  •  Knowledge of appropriate and relevant well engineering tools (e.g. Landmark Suite (or similar) – Wellplan, WellCAT, Stresscheck, Compass, etc), and software packages.
  •  Knowledge of Brazilian well integrity regulations SGIP/SGSO.
  • Familiarity with well testing and well clean-up activities is desirable.
  • Experience with subsea completion and intervention considered an advantage

title: Eletricista
description:
Como Eletricista, você irá auxiliar a equipe de manutenção a garantir a qualidade da infra-estrutura do Hotel, visando a satisfação do hóspede e a excelência na operação dos equipamentos e instalações elétricas, cumprindo as normas e procedimentos de acordo com as políticas do Copacabana Palace e da Belmond.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATIVIDADES DIÁRIAS:

  • Conferir equipamentos, ferramentas e materiais elétricos utilizados no dia a dia, zelando pela vida útil do patrimônio da empresa.
  • Colocar a segurança da instalação, sempre em primeiro plano.
  • Realizar plantões para atendimento em toda infra-estrutura do hotel.
  • Efetuar manutenções de conservação e correção em equipamentos.
  • Fazer novas instalações de equipamentos ou instrumentos quando necessário.
  • Monitorar o funcionamento dos equipamentos da infra-estrutura.
  • Realizar atendimentos em apartamentos com caráter de emergência com agilidade e qualidade.
  • Contribuir com soluções tecnológicas para melhoria da operação e produtividade dos serviços de manutenção.

Requirements

  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos como eletricista de manutenção.
  • Curso técnico em elétrica
  • Conhecimento dos materiais elétricos que serão utilizados nas suas tarefas.
  • Conhecimento sobre funcionamento e montagem em quadros de comandos.
  • Conhecimento de funcionamento de equipamentos eletrônicos.

Benefits

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico extensivo a dependentes diretos.
  • Convênio Farmácia.
  • Vale transporte.
  • Alimentação no local.
  • Descontos nos pontos de vendas da empresa.
  • Folga de Aniversário
  • Seguro de Vida
  • De acordo com o seu "tempo de casa", você adquiri diárias e experiências gratuitas nas propriedades da empresa ao redor do mundo, incluindo 50% de desconto em Alimentos & Bebidas.

Nos esforçamos para criar um ambiente onde nossas(os) colaboradoras(es) possam prosperar tanto pessoal quanto profissionalmente. Com um compromisso em seu desenvolvimento contínuo, você terá a oportunidade de aprender e crescer ao lado de alguns dos indivíduos mais talentosos do setor. Junte-se a nós e faça parte da criação de momentos inesquecíveis para nossos hóspedes, comunidades e uns aos outros.

Este é o seu momento. Inscreva-se hoje

Sobre nós

Um refúgio atemporal no coração de uma cidade movimentada. Um estilo de vida cosmopolita encontra o glamour do mundo antigo no Copacabana Palace. Com bares icônicos, restaurantes com estrela Michelin e um Spa estão todos esperando para serem descobertos dentro de suas paredes art déco.

Inicie sua jornada profissional no mundo da hospitalidade no ícone brasileiro à beira-mar com mais de um século de história.

A Belmond & a família LVMH

Nós do Copacabana Palace, somos orgulhosos em fazer parte da LVMH e da coleção global de hotéis, trens e cruzeiros fluviais Belmond, todos criando experiências excepcionais em todo o mundo. Quando você se junta à nossa propriedade, você se torna parte de uma família global de hotéis ricos em história e destinos deslumbrantes, onde nossas(os) colaboradoras(es) estão no centro da experiência Belmond.

title: Analista de Sistemas ERP
description:
Imagine um local que sabe valorizar seus talentos, com um time que joga junto, respeita quem você é e está sempre em busca da melhor qualidade no que faz.

Essa é a DPC

E você pode ser o próximo a fazer parte da nossa equipe

Confira os requisitos da vaga e envie sua candidatura:

Atuar no suporte, análise e evolução do ERP da empresa, garantindo atendimento às áreas de negócio, parametrização de módulos, análise de dados, suporte funcional, investigação de problemas e participação ativa em projetos de melhoria e implantação.

É um papel funcional, analítico e consultivo e não de desenvolvimento de sistemas.

Requisitos técnicos:

  • Experiência prévia em ERP (qualquer sistema: MXM, Totvs, SAP, Protheus, Dynamics, etc.), seja no suporte, implantação ou como usuário-chave.
  • Capacidade de interpretar processos de negócio (financeiro, contábil, fiscal, compras, faturamento ou estoque).
  • Boa capacidade de leitura e entendimento de regras de negócio, parametrizações e cadastros.
  • Conhecimento intermediário de Excel
  • Experiência em abertura e acompanhamento de chamados, priorização e comunicação com fornecedores.
  • Conhecimento funcional em uma das áreas como:
  • Contabilidade / Fiscal
  • Financeiro
  • Compras / Estoque
  • Faturamento

Desejáveis (diferenciais)

  • Participação em projetos de:
  • Implantação de ERP
  • Atualização de versão
  • Criação de novos processos
  • Integração entre sistemas

Noções de:

  • SQL básico para consultas simples
  • APIs ou integrações (não precisa saber programar)
  • Controle de mudanças / ITIL

Atribuições principais

  • Realizar análise funcional das demandas das áreas de negócio.
  • Parametrização e manutenção de módulos do ERP.
  • Suporte N1 e N2 aos usuários internos e externos.
  • Investigar inconsistências e apoiar o fornecedor do ERP em correções.
  • Executar e documentar testes (versões, correções, integrações).
  • Acompanhar tickets abertos com a fabricante e garantir SLA de resolução.
  • Apoiar projetos de melhorias e novas funcionalidades.
  • Coletar requisitos e propor melhorias nos processos de negócio.
  • Treinar usuários e desenvolver materiais de apoio.

Formação desejada

  • Contabilidade.
  • Áreas de tecnologia.

Benefícios:

  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação: R$ 33,50 por dia útil trabalhado.
  • Plano de Saúde: Sem mensalidade para o colaborador (Extensivo a dependentes, conforme políticas internas).
  • Plano Odontológico: Opcional (Extensivo a dependentes, conforme políticas internas).
  • Seguro de Vida: Zero custo para o colaborador.
  • StarBem: Apoio médico e psicológico online. Zero custo para o colaborador.
  • Programas de saúde e bem estar.
  • Descontos em Farmácias: Através do plano de saúde ou da StarBem.
  • TotalPass: Descontos em atividades físicas em diversas academias.
  • Incentivo ao Esporte: Participação em circuito de corridas de rua.
  • SESC: Tarifas diferenciadas em hospedagem, colônias de férias, atividades físicas, serviços odontológicos e programações culturais.
  • Programa Mamãe DPC: Atenção especial às colaboradoras gestante + Sala exclusiva para lactantes.
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Participação nos Lucros e Rendimentos: Distribuído anualmente.
  • Ações motivacionais de clima e engajamento.
  • Aniversariante do Mês.
  • Programa de Formação: Treinamentos técnicos e comportamentais.
  • Programa de Mentoria: Acompanhamento e desenvolvimento interno para profissionais com grande potencial para se tornarem futuros líderes, proporcionando treinamentos, suporte organizacional, mentorias e projetos desafiadores.
  • Parcerias de Descontos: Universidades, Curso de idiomas e Lazer.
  • Modelo Híbrido: Dois dias de Home Office

Remuneração: Pretensão Salarial.

Local de Trabalho: Cinelândia - Centro/RJ.

title: Analista de Recursos Humanos
description:
Description

Na NOV Subsea Production Systems (SPS) nós impulsionamos a indústria que move o mundo.

Nosso principal negócio é a engenharia, fabricação e entrega de sistemas de dutos flexíveis de alta qualidade para nossos clientes em todo o mundo. Em nossas operações na Dinamarca (Brondby e Kalundborg) e no Brasil (Rio de Janeiro e Porto do Açu), utilizamos engenharia de ponta e tecnologia de fabricação de última geração para fornecer equipamentos submarinos a contratantes globais e empresas de petróleo.

Fazer parte da NOV significa integrar uma organização global, orientada por propósito, comprometida com a excelência operacional, a sustentabilidade e a progressão de carreira a longo prazo. 

Na NOV SPS, você terá um papel essencial em entregar soluções submarinas confiáveis e eficientes, atendendo às demandas energéticas atuais e contribuindo para um futuro mais sustentável.

Sobre a vaga

Como Analista de RH, você irá:

  • Contribuir para o atingimento dos objetivos anuais de RH, baseado nos OKRs estabelecidos pela alta gestão da empresa e pela Diretoria de RH; 
  • Organizar programas de Recursos Humanos, visando a motivação e melhoria no desempenho dos colaboradores;
  • Conduzir processos de recrutamento, atuando de forma estratégica para garantir contratações assertivas, alinhadas à cultura e às necessidades do negócio;
  • Mapear e atender às necessidades de desenvolvimento organizacional, planejando, executando e gerindo o Programa Anual de Treinamento, além de manter os registros dos treinamentos e acompanhar indicadores;
  • Responder a auditorias internas e externas das certificações ISO;
  • Atuar como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) de RH, dando suporte aos gestores em assuntos relacionados ao desenvolvimento e engajamento de equipes, e fortalecimento da cultura organizacional;
  • Promover a melhoria contínua dos processos e o uso de dados para decisões, garantindo alinhamento global, melhoria contínua e impacto nas decisões de negócio;
  • Administrar contratos de prestadores de serviços (como transporte e alimentação), visando a qualidade dos serviços prestados aos colaboradores e atendimento às cláusulas contratuais;
  • Realizar atendimento aos colaboradores, para esclarecimento de dúvidas sobre assuntos pertinentes.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Graduação em Administração, Psicologia, Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência generalista na área de RH e conhecimento de normas e boas práticas do setor;
  • Inglês avançado, com boa conversação;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook);
  • Disponibilidade para residir na cidade do Rio de Janeiro;
  • Disponibilidade para eventuais viagens para nossa fábrica no Porto do Açu (São João da Barra).

Valorizamos pessoas com brilho nos olhos, que pensam diferente e têm vontade de fazer acontecer. Aqui, confiamos uns nos outros, damos espaço para ideias novas e celebramos cada conquista como um time.

Buscamos pessoas que queriam ir além, que acreditem no poder do pensamento inovador e que enxerguem os desafios como oportunidades de crescimento. Acreditamos no trabalho em equipe, na força da colaboração e na confianca como base de tudo o que fazemos. Criamos um ambiente onde é possível aprender, contribuir e extrair o melhor de cada um de nós, todos os dias. Entregar excelência é o nosso compromisso - com os clientes, com a nossa comunidade e com cada profissional que escolhe caminhar ao nosso lado.

O que oferecemos:

Na NOV, valorizamos o bem-estar e o desenvolvimento dos nossos colaboradores. Por isso, além do salário, oferecemos uma série de benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco e Odontológico Metlife para você e seus dependentes legais – totalmente custeados pela empresa;
  • Ticket Alimentação e Ticket Refeição;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Vale Transporte*;
  • Gympass*;
  • PAE – Programa de Apoio ao Empregado;
  • Harvard Manage Mentor – plataforma de cursos gratuitos em parceria com a Universidade de Harvard.

(os itens marcados com * são opcionais e possuem custos específicos)

Traga sua energia, suas ideias e seu talento — juntos, vamos mais longe. Junte-se à NOV SPS e faça parte de uma equipe que move o mundo

Descrição de Cargo

Buscamos um Líder de SAP BTP altamente qualificado e inovador para comandar nossa estratégia de desenvolvimento e integração na nuvem. Este profissional desempenhará um papel central em nossa jornada de transformação digital para o SAP S/4HANA. Como arquiteto e ponto de referência para todas as soluções desenvolvidas na SAP BTP, garantirá que as extensões e inovações suportem robustamente as necessidades do negócio, especialmente no dinâmico setor de energia elétrica.

Responsabilidades 

  • Definir e executar a visão estratégica para o uso da SAP BTP, estabelecendo um roadmap de inovações e garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos de negócio e a arquitetura de TI corporativa.
  • Desenhar e governar a arquitetura de soluções end-to-end na SAP BTP, incluindo integração de aplicações (Cloud Integration), desenvolvimento de extensões (CAP/RAP), gestão de APIs e implementação de soluções de análise de dados (SAP Analytics Cloud).
  • Liderar as frentes de trabalho de extensibilidade durante a implementação do S/4HANA, utilizando a BTP para desenvolver customizações que mantenham o core do S/4HANA limpo.
  • Atuar como um catalisador para a adoção de Inteligência Artificial, explorando serviços de SAP AI Core e SAP AI Business Services para otimizar processos, criar análises preditivas e desenvolver novos produtos e serviços.
  • Liderar equipes de desenvolvimento, gerenciar o ciclo de vida dos projetos na BTP, garantindo cumprimento de prazos, orçamentos e padrões de qualidade.
  • Identificar oportunidades e desenhar soluções na BTP que atendam a desafios específicos do setor, como gestão de ativos (EAM), medição inteligente e comercialização de energia.

Requisitos

  • Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas afins. 
  • Comprovada experiência liderando projetos e desenhando soluções na SAP BTP, com profundo conhecimento em serviços como Cloud Integration, SAP CAP/RAP, SAP Analytics Cloud.
  • Participação ativa em projetos de implementação ou transformação para SAP S/4HANA, com entendimento da estratégia de extensibilidade e do conceito "Keep the Core Clean".
  • Sólida experiência como arquiteto de soluções, com habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas complexas, escaláveis e resilientes.
  • Experiência ou conhecimento profundo dos processos e desafios tecnológicos do setor de energia elétrica.
  • Capacidade de liderar, inspirar e mentorar equipes, além de gerenciar stakeholders em todos os níveis.

title: Manager, Paid Search
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders' contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring for our Paid Media team, looking for a Manager, Paid Search - a performance-driven marketer with a strong mastery of paid search advertising systems, the evolving AI search environment, and a deep understanding of the AI ecosystem and emerging ad platforms. This is not just a tactical role; it requires strategic thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and high standards of execution across digital advertising platforms, particularly Google, YouTube, Bing, and emerging AI platforms like Kontext, Koah, Perplexity, Claude, and OpenAI (some of these platforms don't have ad services yet). Though primarily focused on Google, the role will require expertise and campaign deployment on other paid search based platforms as well, and a willingness to try new platforms as AI search product evolve.

Perfect candidates will be obsessed with Paid Search Advertising, experts at search buying behavior, with a clear demonstrated history of selling products through paid search advertising, scaling ad accounts upwards of $1M USD per month, and having excellent client relationship management skills. You live and breath ads manager, you are curious about the emerging AI advertising ecosystem, and performance marketing at large. You want to be a part of the best team in the business at scaling brands through digital advertising.

You'll report to the Managing Director of the department and play a key role in scaling paid media campaigns across a portfolio of high-growth consumer brands. You'll be responsible for owning creative strategy, campaign builds, optimization, and reporting, while working closely with creative, creator, brand and analytics teams to ensure performance goals are met.

This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment designed for marketers who are ambitious, curious, and ready to grow. You'll gain hands-on experience in a broad range of platforms and verticals, while developing the skills needed to lead performance strategies end-to-end.

Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal, Brazil, and Mexico

What you'll do:

  • Plan, develop, and implement comprehensive paid media strategies exclusively focused on Paid Search to increase brand visibility and drive new user acquisition and leads via paid media campaigns.

  • Conduct thorough brand and website audits to understand our clients' key value propositions, core products, and brand aesthetics and identify opportunities to successfully market them and make them stand out in the marketplace.

  • Obsession with the paid search advertising action, bid system, and market dynamics to best convert customers at the lowest possible cost for the brand.

  • Keen to develop innovative paid search strategies that blend traditional search, YouTube, and emerging AI search.

  • Conduct competitive research to ensure success in the ad space and new acquisition audience targeting.

  • Manage between 6-10 Paid Media accounts (including but not limited to: Google, YouTube, Bing, and the emerging AI sSearch Platforms (Koah, Kontext) on behalf of Darkroom clients, with aggregate monthly spends ranging between $20,000 - $3M.

  • Utilize Platform Ad Managers, third-party reporting tools, and AI to develop insights and action items intended to increase our clients' revenues month-over-month and solve for attribution.

  • Religious mastery of important KPIs like CPA, CAC, iROAS, nCAC, MER, aMER, CTR, and CPM.

  • Understand industry-wide benchmarks throughout all steps in the e-commerce marketing funnel.

  • Implement real-time, proactive, and reactionary ad-buying decisions across multiple platforms in response to up-or-down trends happening on ads platforms (you will be in ad platforms daily).

  • Preemptively develop quarterly strategies for clientele based on perceived success metrics, ad spends, YoY performance metrics, and projections.

  • Deep dive into competitor research, industry knowns, and brand identity to manage client expectations and continually brainstorm new marketing initiatives, creative assets, copy, and review after results.

  • Understand full-funnel marketing strategies to ensure new customer acquisition is healthy within the broader e-commerce equation.

  • Understand client needs for success and preemptively deliver projections and forecasts that latter into client quarterly strategy.

  • Willingness and openness to learn and understand e-commerce P&Ls with a comfortability engaging with financial metrics.

What you'll need to be successful:

  • Mastery of the e-commerce marketing funnel —> offer to ad to landing page to conversion.

  • 4+ years minimum of paid media advertising experience within Paid Search, Google in specific (building high converting funnels and driving quantifiable results).

  • 3+ years minimum managing paid search advertising for growing clients in the consumer space spending over $400k+ minimum monthly aggregate spend.

  • Expertise in developing, testing, and optimizing advertisement copy and short form video creative

  • Expertise in creative consultation for successful Paid Social Ads that convert

  • Background in data-derived decision-making and forecasting budgets/spend projections linked to perceived results

  • Experience with all core e-commerce revenue drivers, reporting on metrics that actually matter (CPA, CAC, iROAS, aMER, CPM)

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you'll thrive here.

  • Work-Life Balance: We recognize that time away from work is essential for growth and well-being. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have the time you need to maintain a healthy work-life balance and perform at your best.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona

  • Generous Quarterly Bonuses: Your productivity directly translates to your compensation. We offer a competitive quarterly bonus structure that is both substantial and customized to your role, ensuring your hard work is consistently and generously rewarded.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

description:
Projeto de Inovação na empresa Supergasbras em parceria com IEL e IPT
Supergasbras
Empresa holandesa familiar mas com escala global. É a maior distribuidora mundial de GLP, servindo mais de 300 milhões de clientes. Sendo o Brasil um dos seus maiores mercados, foi aqui estabelecido um Hub de Inovação com o objetivo de testar e acelerar novas tecnologias e modelos de negócio, com foco no mercado de botijões de GLP. As inovações que estão sendo desenvolvidas tem como foco criar mais valor para o consumidor, mas também otimizar a nossa cadeia de valor, otimizando processos e reduzindo custos de distribuição.
Projeto:
Co- Desenvolvimento de tecnologias e modelos de negócio para continuidade energética de GLP
Contexto: pesquisar e desenvolver tecnologias para monitoramento de nível de gás em botijões GLP, de forma a garantir uma continuidade energética aos clientes e otimizar o processo de distribuição de GLP ao longo da cadeia de valor. Com as tecnologias pretende-se reformular o modelo de negócios existente com o objetivo de oferecer ao cliente a possibilidade de pagamento por kilo de GLP consumido ao invés da troca do botijão apenas quando o mesmo estiver vazio. A Supergasbras entende que o co-desenvolvimento com parceiros (universidades, startups, e instituto de pesquisas) pode acelerar a implementação do projeto bem como impulsionar parcerias ganha-ganha onde ambos terão acesso à cadeia de valor e a locais de testes. Ao longo desse trabalho, é expectável o aparecimento de novas oportunidades de negócio, portanto o desenvolvimento de uma rede de parceiros em torno da temática é também um objetivo do projeto.
Pré-requisitos: Graduados com 1 ano de experiência na área de execução do projeto ou PD&I
Formação:
Graduados em: Administração, Marketing estratégico, Design e áreas relacionadas

Experiência anterior com Gestão de Produto, Estratégia, Marketing, etc. Ter interesse em trabalhar com modelagem de negócio, metodologias de design.
Inglês sinta-se confortável para conversação (contato com time global)

description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What we do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About the Role

GenAI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills. If you join the platform as an AI Tutor in US Law, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate on these projects.

Although every project is unique, you might typically:

  • You hold an academic degree in Law (Bachelor, J.D., LLM, FLLM) or associate degree in paralegal studies.

Benefits

Buscamos pessoas que queiram crescer junto com a gente e que tenham vontade de fazer a diferença todos os dias Veja o que valorizamos por aqui:

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

title: Partnership Officer
description:
The Partnership Officer will play a key role in expanding our business by cultivating and managing relationships with a diverse range of partners. This role requires a highly organized and motivated individual with excellent relationship management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Responsibilities

  • Create a systematic, process-driven approach for partner outreach and relationship management.
  • Develop an on-boarding plan and certification program to the partners to be completed following the enablement and orientation sessions.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop and implement joint marketing, sales, and support initiatives.
  • Collaborate with senior management, Business Development teams, and Strategy Manager to align our internal goals with new and existing partner relationships in LATAM.
  • Represent ProgressSoft at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to promote brand awareness and build strategic relationships.
  • Negotiate partnership agreements and contracts, ensuring terms are mutually beneficial and aligned with ProgressSoft´s objectives.
  • Develop a "Partner Kit" and collaborate with the marketing team to ensure partners receive the appropriate materials including branding guidelines, product summaries and presentations as applicable.
  • Work in liaison with the Business Development member handling the assigned territory to align on partnership agreement scopes, quotas, products covered, exclusivity, etc...
  • Maintain an ongoing relationship with current partners and offer new ways to grow the partnership.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers at partner organizations.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams, including Business Development, Marketing, strategy, Product Development, and Operations, to support partnership initiatives and drive results.
  • Identify and source partnership opportunities through inbound lead follow-up and outbound cold calls, emails, and client visits in LATAM.
  • Proactively seek out new partnership opportunities that align with the company's strategic goals, Business Development team's needs, and potentially complimentary products.
  • Analyze potential partnerships to assess strategic fit, value proposition, and potential ROI.
  • Stay up to date on industry trends, competitor activities, and identify emerging technologies and partners.
  • Forecast, measure, and report the results of various projects with partners, including co-created and/or co-branded content promotions, lead sharing, and/or event partnerships.
  • Analyze partnership performance, challenges, and opportunities to provide regular reports and insights to internal stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Possesses 3-5 years of experience in partnership management. 
  • Experienced in the IT and banking industry best practices, with a strong understanding of emerging technologies and their impact on financial services. 
  • Excellent knowledge of local LATAM payments infrastructure & industry.
  • Proven track record of successfully developing and managing partnerships.
  • Ability to track and analyze partnership performance. 
  • Ability to evolve in a complex environment.
  • Ability to operate with complete independence and autonomy.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent negotiation and strategic thinking skills. 
  • Proficiency in written and verbal communication in English is a must.
